name: CLIENT: D&E Remodeling — consultation requests + calm follow-up

parameters.content:
## D&E Remodeling lead machine
Consultation requests come from tbsol.net/clients/remodel (or any form posting to this webhook).

What happens automatically:
1. D&E gets an instant lead alert (you're CC'd)
2. The homeowner gets an instant, calm confirmation
3. Day 3: a gentle no-pressure nudge
4. Day 10: a final soft check-in, then it stops

### Tone rule (important)
This client's whole promise is NO PRESSURE. Every message to the
homeowner must stay calm and low-key. No urgency, no 'act now',
no sales push. Two follow-ups maximum, then we leave them alone.

### Setup
1. Replace CLIENT_EMAIL_HERE in the marked nodes with D&E's real email.
2. Attach your email credential on all 4 Email nodes.
3. Save → flip **Active**.

Lead page to give the client: https://tbsol.net/clients/remodel

parameters.subject: =New consultation request: {{ $json.body.name }} — {{ $json.body.service }}
Thanks for reaching out — we've got your request
parameters.text:
=Hi {{ $json.body.name }},

Thank you for reaching out about your {{ $json.body.service }}. We have your
request and we'll be in touch shortly to find a time that works for you.

A few things worth saying up front, so you know what to expect:

  - The consultation is free, and there's no obligation of any kind.
  - It's a conversation, not a quote visit. We'll listen first.
  - You will never be asked to decide on the spot.

We'll walk your space together at your pace, explain your options in plain
language, and talk honestly about cost and timeline. Ask us as many questions
as you'd like — that's what the visit is for.

If anything changes or you'd rather reach us directly, just reply to this
email or call (484) 841-8501.

Talk soon,
D&E Remodeling
Woman-owned - Kitchens, baths, and plumbing-related basements

parameters.subject: Still happy to answer questions, whenever you're ready
parameters.text:
=Hi {{ $json.body.name }},

Just a quiet follow-up on your {{ $json.body.service }} — no pressure at all.

If you're still in the thinking-it-through stage, that's completely normal, and
honestly it's the right way to approach a project like this. Whenever you'd
like to talk it over, we're glad to come out and walk through it with you.

And if you'd rather just ask a question or two by email first, reply here and
we'll answer plainly — no sales pitch attached.

Either way, we hope the project goes well for you.

D&E Remodeling
(484) 841-8501

parameters.subject: Last note from us — the door stays open
parameters.text:
=Hi {{ $json.body.name }},

This is the last you'll hear from us unless you reach out — we don't believe in
chasing people, and we know you have plenty going on.

If your {{ $json.body.service }} is still on your mind next month, or next year,
the offer stands: a free, no-pressure conversation whenever the timing is right
for you. Nothing expires.

And if you end up working with someone else, we genuinely hope it goes well. If
it helps, here are the questions worth asking any contractor before you sign:
are they registered and insured, who's actually in your home each day, how are
changes priced and approved, and what's the payment schedule. A good one will
welcome all four.

Best of luck with the project.

D&E Remodeling
(484) 841-8501
